item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now affecting the coast of southern China will move slightly away tomorrow. There will still be a few showers over the region. The trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of Guangdong again in the following couple of days. There will be more showers and thunderstorms over the region. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, showers will lessen over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week. The weather will improve slightly.
